visual_description: A professional optical level (sighting scope) mounted on a heavy-duty collapsible aluminum tripod. The level is painted a high-visibility yellow with a sunshade over the lens. A circular bubble level is visible on the side. It is shown standing on a rugged, uneven dirt surface, perfectly level.

constraints.material: Anodized aluminum tripod legs; high-gloss yellow paint on the scope.
constraints.logic: Used to determine the 'Z' (vertical) coordinate of a fossil.
